opendb_id.description: Unique identifier for the document (UUID v4)

seat_height_range_mm.description: Manufacturer-published floor-to-seat height range for this exact chair configuration, in mm. Do not substitute an overall chair-height range. If both endpoints are present, minimum must not exceed maximum.

min.description: Lowest published floor-to-seat height in mm; do not estimate. Use an official source for the exact sold variant. Leave missing when unknown or unverified, and convert official units without implying extra precision.

max.description: Highest published floor-to-seat height in mm; do not estimate. Use an official source for the exact sold variant. Leave missing when unknown or unverified, and convert official units without implying extra precision.

seat_dimensions_mm.description: Published usable seat-pan dimensions in mm, not overall chair dimensions. Leave missing measurements unset when unknown or unverified.

width.description: Published usable seat-pan width in mm. Use an official source for the exact sold variant; do not substitute overall width or infer the measurement from images. Convert official units without implying extra precision.

depth.description: Published usable seat-pan depth in mm. Use an official source for the exact sold variant; do not substitute overall depth or infer the measurement from images. Convert official units without implying extra precision.

dimensions_mm.description: Published overall dimensions of the assembled chair in mm, excluding packaging. Leave missing measurements unset when unknown or unverified. If both height endpoints are present, minimum must not exceed maximum.

width.description: Overall chair width with armrests in the manufacturer's stated normal position, in mm. Use an official source for the exact sold variant; do not infer the measurement from images. Convert official units without implying extra precision.

depth.description: Overall chair depth while upright, in mm. Use an official source for the exact sold variant; do not infer the measurement from images. Convert official units without implying extra precision.

height_min.description: Minimum published overall chair height in mm. Use an official source for the exact sold variant. Leave missing when unknown or unverified, and convert official units without implying extra precision.

height_max.description: Maximum published overall chair height in mm. Use an official source for the exact sold variant. Leave missing when unknown or unverified, and convert official units without implying extra precision.

base_diameter_mm.description: Published outer diameter of the assembled chair base in mm; do not estimate from images. Use an official source for the exact sold variant. Leave unset when unknown or unverified, and convert official units without implying extra precision.

max_user_weight_kg.description: Manufacturer's maximum supported or warranted seated user weight for this exact variant in kg; not recommended user weight. Use an official source for the exact sold variant. Leave unset when unknown or unverified, and convert official units without implying extra precision.

weight_kg.description: Weight of the assembled chair in kg, excluding packaging. Use an official source for the exact sold variant; do not substitute shipping weight. Leave unset when unknown or unverified, and convert official units without implying extra precision.

seat_surface_materials.description: Manufacturer-stated seat contact-surface materials for this exact sold configuration; do not combine upholstery options. Leave unset when unknown or unverified; do not store an empty array to mean unknown.

backrest_surface_materials.description: Manufacturer-stated backrest contact-surface materials for this exact sold configuration; do not assume they match the seat. Do not combine upholstery choices from a model family. Leave unset when unknown or unverified; do not store an empty array to mean unknown.

armrest_adjustability.description: Adjustment capability of the armrests included with this configuration; use NoArmrests only with explicit evidence. Leave unset when the exact included armrest configuration is unknown or unverified.

lumbar_support.description: Dedicated lumbar support included with this configuration; use None only with explicit evidence, and do not infer support from a shaped back. Leave unset when the exact included lumbar-support configuration is unknown or unverified.

general_product_information.description: General product information and retailer SKUs

variant.description: Exact sold size, upholstery, and support configuration when any of those details distinguish this chair record.

last_manually_spec_verified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the part specs were last manually verified by a human

retailer_listings.description: Canonical retailer product listings used for pricing

identifiers.description: Current versioned product identity snapshot used for retailer and pricing matching
